item.title: US Loses Measles Elimination Status as Outbreak Surges
item.description: Health officials say the US lost measles elimination status as cases top 5,400 this year, driven by a deadly Pennsylvania outbreak nationwide.

item.title: US Loses Measles Elimination Status, Years to Recovery
item.description: After 26 years, the US lost measles elimination status as transmission continues, prompting calls for higher vaccination rates and additional funding.

item.title: New York Measles Death Highlights Vaccine Crisis in US
item.description: First measles death in New York in 30+ years underscores a national surge, with seven U.S. fatalities this year amid declining vaccination rates.

item.title: Hospitals Revamp Measles Protocols Amid 2026 Surge
item.description: U.S. hospitals deploy revamped screening, isolation and telehealth workflows to combat a record measles outbreak, protecting vulnerable patients.
